links.outcome: Correlation between model self-reported confidence rating and answer correctness on exam questions
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o answered 88 of 120 correctly (73.3%), but its self-reported confidence levels did not largely correlate with accuracy, so it could not consistently predict its own performance.
links.quote: The model's self-reported confidence levels did not largely correlate with its response accuracy.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks GPT-4o on a medical specialty examination (Polish State Specialization Examination in vascular surgery) to measure accuracy and self-reported confidence, without testing deployment practices or safeguards.
